Ravi - Security: I'll export rotation metadata (redacted). Note: full key material never leaves customer KMS for Private.

```
question_id,artifact_filename,artifact_type,owner,link,notes
E-2,kms-rotation-2026-02-12.csv,csv,Ravi - Security,s3://redwood-sales/mapletrust/sig/,redacted key ids
N-4/vpc-peering.pdf,pdf,Claire (Solutions),s3://redwood-sales/mapletrust/arch/,includes private endpoints
E-5,key-policy-summary.pdf,pdf,Ravi - Security,confluence://sec/key-policies,excerpted policy
```
